facts.fact: SlickText's pricing page says that paying yearly instead of monthly gets the customer 2 months free.
facts.quote: Pay yearly and get 2 months free

facts.fact: SlickText's pricing page says its free trial requires no credit card.
facts.quote: No credit card required

facts.fact: SlickText's own SMS Benchmark Report, which SlickText describes as its research, cites SMS click rate benchmarks drawn from over 400 million messages.
facts.quote: See SMS click rate benchmarks from over 400 million messages.

facts.fact: SlickText's entry SMS plan costs $29 per month and includes 500 credits per month.
facts.quote: Price per month  $29  500 credits per month

facts.fact: SlickText's second SMS plan costs $49 per month and includes 1,000 credits per month.
facts.quote: Price per month  $49  1,000 credits per month

facts.fact: SlickText's third SMS plan costs $79 per month and includes 2,000 credits per month.
facts.quote: Price per month  $79  2,000 credits per month

facts.fact: SlickText's fourth SMS plan costs $129 per month and includes 3,500 credits per month.
facts.quote: Price per month  $129  3,500 credits per month

facts.fact: SlickText's fifth SMS plan costs $169 per month and includes 5,000 credits per month.
facts.quote: Price per month  $169  5,000 credits per month

facts.fact: SlickText's top listed SMS plan costs $319 per month and includes 10,000 credits per month.
facts.quote: Price per month  $319  10,000 credits per month

facts.fact: SlickText's plans listed on the pricing page include unlimited contacts.
facts.quote: Unlimited contacts

facts.fact: SlickText's plans listed on the pricing page include free incoming texts.
facts.quote: Free incoming texts

facts.fact: SlickText's plans listed on the pricing page include rollover credits.
facts.quote: Rollover credits

facts.fact: SlickText's plans listed on the pricing page include one premium sending number.
facts.quote: One premium sending number

facts.fact: SlickText's monthly plan priced at $579 per month includes 25,000 credits per month.
facts.quote: Price per month  $579  25,000 credits per month

facts.fact: SlickText's second listed monthly plan is priced at $939 per month and includes 50,000 credits per month.
facts.quote: Price per month  $939  50,000 credits per month

facts.fact: SlickText offers eligible nonprofits 20% off any standard plan.
facts.quote: Eligible nonprofits receive 20% off any standard SlickText plan.

facts.fact: SlickText's RCS messaging carries a $500 one-time setup fee.
facts.quote: RCS is available for a $500 one-time setup fee and a $200 annual maintenance fee.

facts.fact: SlickText states it currently supports SMS messaging in the United States and Canada.
facts.quote: SlickText currently supports SMS messaging in **the United States and Canada.**

facts.fact: SlickText's free trial lasts 14 days and requires no credit card.
facts.quote: During your free trial, you’ll get 14 days to experience every feature. There’s no credit card required

facts.fact: SlickText's annual plans include two free months of message credits.
facts.quote: Annual plans unlock two free months of message credits

facts.fact: SlickText rollover credits from monthly plans remain usable for one month following the billing date, while annual plans allow one year.
facts.quote: Monthly plans include one month of rollover texts. Annual plans include one year of rollover texts.

facts.fact: Under SlickText's credit counting, one message credit equals one industry standard SMS segment (160 characters) to one subscriber.
facts.quote: Each message credit is equal to one industry standard SMS message segment to one subscriber. An SMS message segment contains 160 characters.

facts.fact: SlickText states an MMS message consumes 3 message credits per segment, and an MMS segment can contain up to 1,600 characters.
facts.quote: An MMS (message sent with an image or other supported file types) consumes 3 message credits per segment. However, an MMS message segment can contain up to 1,600 characters.

facts.fact: SlickText says sending numbers are typically registered within a few hours of request, per its own claim.
facts.quote: In many cases your sending number is registered within a few hours of your request.

facts.fact: SlickText's review badges cite over 1,900 G2 reviews and over 250 Capterra reviews.
facts.quote: 1,900+ reviews

facts.fact: SlickText's Enterprise plan is custom-quoted, with no published price.
facts.quote: Reach out for a custom-built quote.

facts.fact: SlickText plans starting at $129 include a free 1-on-1 onboarding session with its client success team.
facts.quote: Plans starting at $129 include a free 1-on-1 onboarding session with our client success team

facts.fact: SlickText plan sizes of $579/month and above include access to a dedicated Customer Success Manager.
facts.quote: Plan sizes of $579/month and above include access to a dedicated Customer Success Manager

facts.fact: SlickText states that carrier fees are passed through to customers at no additional markup.
facts.quote: We pass these fees through to you at no additional markup.

facts.fact: SlickText will match any SimpleTexting standard plan price.
facts.quote: We'll match any SimpleTexting standard plan price.

facts.fact: On SlickText, one SMS message consumes 1 credit and one MMS message consumes 3 credits.
facts.quote: 1 SMS = 1 credit. 1 MMS = 3 credits.

facts.fact: SlickText has powered over 124,000 text message programs since 2011, according to the vendor.
facts.quote: SlickText has powered over 124,000 text message programs since 2011.

facts.fact: SlickText's page states that standard message and data rates may apply in the US and Canada.
facts.quote: Standard message & data rates may apply in the US & Canada.

facts.fact: SlickText's footer states that it is a 100% opt-in service and does not provide lists of phone numbers.
facts.quote: SlickText is a 100% opt-in service. We do not provide lists of phone numbers

facts.fact: SlickText states that taxes will be included where appropriate in plan prices.
facts.quote: Taxes will be included where appropriate.

facts.fact: SlickText's high-speed toll-free phone number comes with fast-track verification.
facts.quote: Your high-speed toll-free phone number comes with fast-track verification to get you sending as soon as possible.
